additional_concerns: All 12 required pairs are retained. NOT_APPLICABLE addresses the exact selected gift questions; it neither rejects the supported duties nor establishes candidate correctness or authorizes pruning.

The advertising claim's uncertainty metadata is stale: footnote 4 and surrounding marketing paragraphs are supplied. The Advertising Guidelines and their supplementary FAQs and guidance remain missing external authorities.

The external Code of Conduct paragraph 3.11 and the answer to question 1 of the SFC Code of Conduct FAQs issued on 30 September 2010 are absent. Can their applicable versions be supplied to verify gift, discount and product-type classifications? No external dependency IDs are supplied.

Scope placement changes executable answers. For a known distributor and an unoffered component, node.2a6321b4ce90763bf0be564e returns OUT_OF_SCOPE, whereas node.142f34016b300f5c110eb249 and node.bc55be7e973a689d07f9e64b can return FALSE. Node.97af37a2579f59b0ee43211f similarly places offering and promotional linkage in scope. Whether these cases should be outside assessment or answered as not caught remains unresolved.

Node.968dbccb08282a4e8a580ae5 and node.bca408c75cbf8467afafada6 place promotional linkage in scope, returning OUT_OF_SCOPE when it is false. Repeating scope predicates in the result does not produce the typed negative answer. Node.6d6e7adc6faa9d94b74c08e5 likewise returns OUT_OF_SCOPE for an unlinked benefit rather than TRUE for satisfaction of the selected gift control.

An unknown scope returns UNKNOWN even when a known non-gift or discount would decide an otherwise unscoped gift formula. This is an observable runtime distinction; the circular does not prescribe these evaluation conventions.

The offer-level candidates combine offer-level promotional linkage with an existential non-discount gift classification. The source states, "If gifts are offered in such a way that they are linked to a particular type of investment product". Unless the supplied facts establish that the identified gift participates in the linked promotion, these formulas could combine an unrelated gift with another component's promotional link. Whether the offer-wide relationship establishes the required connection remains unresolved.

Node.968dbccb08282a4e8a580ae5 states, "False requires sufficient evidence that no offered component meets both conditions; unresolved classification remains unknown." Node.bca408c75cbf8467afafada6 does not expressly impose that completeness requirement. Generic UNKNOWN semantics do not implement component enumeration or validate an externally supplied FALSE.

The circular's distributor definition concerns SFC-authorised funds, while the quoted paragraph 3.11 refers to investment products generally. Fund-specific predicates may fit the circular's application, but their equivalence to the full underlying Code provision is not established.

The source says guaranteed returns or incentives "may be considered a gift" and distinguishes fund returns from distributor top-ups. Automatic gift classification would add an unsupported restriction; treating all guaranteed returns as exempt would add an unsupported permission. The candidates generally leave classification to supplied judgment.

The discount exception and TRUE_IS_COMPLIANT result concern the selected gift control only. Neither establishes overall legality. Conversely, section 103 authorisation or exemption is not a stated gift exception.

Node.bc55be7e973a689d07f9e64b focuses on who offers the component rather than who funds or fulfils it. Offering rather than receipt is supported by the source, but disputed attribution, agency and third-party arrangements remain unimplemented classification questions.

The source packet does not establish the candidates' concrete effective interval. The FAQ date is not an effective date for every rule. Historical applicability and relevant external-authority versions remain unresolved.
